issue_request: FHIR-18353 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core extensibility. It requested more nuance around the requirement to refuse to process unknown modifier extensions, replacing broad process wording with a definition of processing the data of a resource or affected element.

FHIR-I 2019-04-15 minutes confirm the final 10-0-0 vote to clarify that 'refuse to process' means 'refuse to process the data of'. Related modifier-extension issues from the same meeting have already been represented separately on the combined branch.
